name: Crate & Barrel
instructionsEn: There are 3 Ways to Redeem your eGift Card: 1) Online at CrateandBarrel.com, CB2.com, or LandofNod.com. Give the eGift Card number and PIN to the Customer Service associate. 3) Visit a Crate & Barrel, CB2, or The Land of Nod store and display the eGift Card number and PIN to the cashier at the time of purchase. Customer Service Associate: Hand key the eGift Card number and PIN into the POS.
termsEn: This Crate & Barrel eGift Card is redeemable for merchandise or services at Crate & Barrel stores and Outlets (U.S. only), online at CrateandBarrel.com or by phone to 800.323.5461. Purchases will be deducted from this eGift Card’s balance until the value reaches zero dollars. Funds on this eGift Card do not expire and cannot be redeemed for cash, except where required by law. Crate & Barrel is not responsible for lost, stolen or damaged eGift Cards, or any unauthorized use. Your acceptance or use of this eGift Card constitutes agreement to these terms and conditions, which may change at any time. To check your balance, visit CrateandBarrel.com/GiftCards or call 877.477.4567. For Customer Service, call 800.606.6458.
